anomaly_label: Jumpy heater (H702, H706, H704, H708) power

evidence.observation: Buffer differential pressure was 1.913 mbar, consistent with the preceding baseline near 2 mbar.
Buffer differential pressure jumped to 5.728 mbar while system pressure fell to 395.962 mbar.
Buffer differential pressure remains elevated at 3.244 mbar; column differential pressure fell to 0.029 mbar despite system pressure recovering to 398.807 mbar.
T701 fell from 283.122 to 240.123 °C over two minutes; T702 also declined, while T703 nearly plateaued at 56.117 °C.

args.missing_evidence: Protocol phase, heater commands and pressure/valve setpoints are needed to distinguish an intended transition from a process fault; verify pressure measurements and buffer flow path. No composition measurement or separation target is provided.
